description: PLANKA is an elegant, Trello-like kanban board for team project tracking: projects, boards, lists and cards with real-time updates, labels, members, due dates, checklists and attachments — self-hosted, with a free Community edition.
name: PLANKA
seoDescription: Deploy PLANKA with Docker Compose on Dokploy — the elegant self-hosted kanban board for team project tracking, with PostgreSQL and a seeded first administrator.
